description.zh:
下一个查询开始Token，用来返回更多结果。
> 第一次查询不需要提供本参数，如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的**NextToken**值以继续查询。
description.en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

> This parameter is not required for the first request. If not all results are returned in one query, you can specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of **NextToken**.
The resource type. Valid values: **INSTANCE** or **instance**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-tags --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --next-token 212db86sca4384811e0b5e8707ec20000 --region cn-hangzhou
